protocol:
Chapter 14, section 14.3: calibration of a ten-member deep ensemble of PINNs for Running Example A.

Protocol (experiments/ch14new/spec/ch14-e02.yaml): heat equation of Chapter 1 (nu = 0.5, T = 0.2,
two-mode initial condition); each member is the 3x32 tanh PINN of Chapter 1 (code/ch01/exA_three_ways_pytorch.py:
same architecture, initialization, and collocation construction, n_r = 2000, n_b = n_0 = 100), trained with
Adam (1500 iterations, learning rate 1e-3) and no L-BFGS stage; members use seeds 0-9. The ensemble mean m and
standard deviation s at 200 evaluation points drawn uniformly in [0,1] x [0,T] (seed 999) define Gaussian
intervals m +- z_q s; empirical coverage of the exact solution is reported at five nominal levels.
A second set of 200 points (seed 1999) shows the evaluation-set variability, and a set of 2000 points
(seed 2999) gives the coverage with small sampling error.

Run from the project root with the project venv:
    _revision_work/venv/Scripts/python.exe code/ch14new/calibration_check.py
